## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Verona, Italy. It starts at 4 Piazza di Sopra.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take a break from city life with a day trip to Villa dei Cedri's Garda Thermal Park. Located in the scenic beauty of Lake Garda, this paradise offers pristine lakes, a swimming pool, waterfalls, and fountains.
>
> The park's thermal waters range from 29-30°C, sometimes reaching 37°C, known for their health benefits and anti-inflammatory properties.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €44.99. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 284 ratings and 89 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
